description: Assess how a takedown for this URL would proceed: where the notice goes (host, platform, or a hidden host that must be revealed first), what documents and attestation the content owner must supply, the step-by-step process, and the legal caveats (§512(f), scope limits). Read-only; does not judge the merits of the claim and files nothing. Use resolve_host first if you only need the hosting answer.

url.description: The infringing URL or bare domain

what.description: One line on what was copied (e.g. "my photo set", "my course videos") — echoed into the plan, not judged
